harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Hardened OpenSSH on node1. Only ssh-access members may authenticate using public keys; root, contractor, passwords, keyboard-interactive authentication, and node3 network access are denied. The prepared opsadmin key remains unchanged, is pinned to node2, and permits non-interactive access while denying PTYs. All three nodes were restarted serially and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Installed a validated sshd hardening drop-in requiring public-key authentication and ssh-access membership.
Explicitly denied root and contractor access and disabled password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Pinned opsadmin’s existing key to node2 at 10.100.6.11 with restrictive non-interactive key options, preserving its fingerprint.
Created the dedicated ssh-admin firewalld zone, allowed SSH only from node2, and removed SSH from the public zone.
Verified node2 access, node3 network denial, prepared-data integrity, and configuration persistence.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Public-key-only SSH for ssh-access members; root, contractor, passwords, and interactive PTYs denied
evidence.summary: Effective sshd policy requires publickey and ssh-access, disables password/keyboard-interactive and root access, and explicitly denies contractor. Live tests show opsadmin non-interactive success and PTY, contractor-password, and root failures.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated ssh-admin boundary allows node2 and blocks node3
evidence.summary: ssh-admin contains source 10.100.6.11/32 and SSH; public has no SSH. Node2 succeeds while node3 receives a network-layer rejection, including after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Prepared accounts, keys, and data preserved
evidence.summary: The opsadmin key fingerprint remained SHA256:9YfbD75uiEP1VfjwCqzbmx5wJUeWyzavXTa15hBfmds; prepared data hashes, accounts, permissions, and node2 key state remained intact.
Boot ID changed from 437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e to 43273114-9dee-404b-9c45-a3526720e7d0. sshd, firewalld, firewall policy, data, allowed node2 access, and node3 denial recovered.
Boot ID changed from c207ab79-d913-4af0-b630-8f0104ee3ccd to e8d9bce7-1c45-4f3a-9d00-9774711d738e. sshd, sshprobe account/key state, and live access to node1 recovered.
Boot ID changed from a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f to e5bc8e6f-6bda-425d-9f46-eac35985c09c. sshd and stable machine data recovered, while access to node1 TCP/22 remained blocked.
